name: Congenital Mitral Stenosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Echocardiographic Diagnostic Criteria for Congenital Mitral Stenosis

criteria.description: Thickened mitral valve leaflets with restricted mobility on echocardiography
Reduced mitral valve orifice area consistent with stenosis (typically <1.5 cm²)
Left atrial enlargement secondary to mitral inflow obstruction
Presence of a low-pitched, rumbling mid-diastolic murmur best heard at the apex

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of mitral valve leaflet thickening with restricted mobility and reduced mitral valve orifice area on echocardiography, plus auscultatory evidence of diastolic murmur
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily based on echocardiographic findings supported by clinical examination.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Mid-diastolic rumbling murmur at cardiac apex
searchTerms: rumbling heart sound in middle heart relaxation
mitral valve leaflets not moving well

common.symptomName: Exercise intolerance due to reduced cardiac output
searchTerms: poor exercise ability from weak heart
exercise intolerance due to low heart output

occasional.symptomName: Hemoptysis secondary to pulmonary venous hypertension
searchTerms: coughing up blood from lung vein pressure
hemoptysis due to lung vein hypertension
blood in sputum from pulmonary venous high pressure
shortness of breath when lying down
difficulty breathing flat due to lung fluid

rare.symptomName: Systemic embolism from left atrial thrombus
searchTerms: blood clots from left atrium causing strokes
swelling and fatigue from right heart failure

laboratory: Elevated B-type natriuretic peptide (BNP) in advanced cases
imaging: Echocardiography showing thickened mitral valve leaflets with reduced orifice area
Left atrial enlargement on chest X-ray
Pulmonary venous congestion on chest radiograph
genetic: No specific genetic mutation identified; may be associated with congenital heart defect syndromes
other: Electrocardiogram showing left atrial enlargement and possible atrial arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Commissural fusion of mitral valve leaflets

redFlags: Signs of congestive heart failure in infancy
references: Moss and Adams' Heart Disease in Infants, Children, and Adolescents, 9th Edition
American Heart Association Guidelines for Pediatric Heart Disease
